MenuItem.Name: Dump recent protocol traffic to log

Field.Label:
This records what your panel sends for a few minutes and writes a shareable file (no password, no user codes). It NEVER arms or disarms anything — you do that on your keypad, it only listens.
While it is running, please do these on your keypad (the log shows the states updating as you go): 1. Open and close a zone (a door or window) 2. Arm STAY, let it arm, then disarm 3. Arm AWAY, let the exit delay run right through until armed, then disarm 4. Arm AWAY, open your entry door, let the entry countdown run about 10 seconds, then disarm before the siren 5. Arm INSTANT (code then 7) and Arm MAX (code then 4), disarming after each
When it finishes it writes a JSON file to /tmp and tells you whether it is safe to share.
